extDescription.message: Create custom CSS themes for the websites you visit, by hand or with AI.

optionsAccessLead.message: PageCraft only runs on sites you enable. Enable sites from the popup, or all sites here.

optionsAccessNone.message: Not enabled on any site yet.

optionsAiLead.message: Choose which AI writes your themes. Keys are stored only in this browser and sent only to the provider you pick.

optionsBackupHelp.message: Exports contain styles and site rules, never API keys, history or conversations. Imported CSS is checked and external references are removed.

optionsDigestSize.message: Page detail sent to the AI

optionsFramesHelp.message: (each frame uses the style for its own site; presets apply everywhere)

optionsInjectionSaved.message: Saved. Open tabs update right away.

optionsKeyLockedNote.message: Your keys are protected. Unlock them under Key protection to view or change them.

optionsKeysLead.message: Optionally encrypt your API keys with a passphrase. You'll enter it once per browser session. This protects keys on disk; it can't protect against malware on an unlocked computer.

optionsModelPlaceholder.message: Load models or type an id

optionsModelsFound.message: Found {0} models. Pick one in the Model field.

optionsNeedsProviderAccess.message: PageCraft needs permission to contact {0}. Allow it when the browser asks.

optionsNoThemes.message: No styles yet. Open the CustomStyle editor from the popup on any site to create one.

optionsOverridesHelp.message: Pause PageCraft on a site, or change iframe and web-component behaviour for one site.

optionsPassphraseWarning.message: If you forget it, you'll need to enter your API keys again. There is no recovery.

optionsPricesHelp.message: Enter your provider's current prices in US dollars per million tokens. PageCraft doesn't ship prices because they change; without them it shows token counts only.

optionsPrivacyText.message: When you press Generate or Review, PageCraft sends your instructions, the recent conversation, your current theme (when refining) and a short page description (URL without query string, title, DOM outline, colors, fonts, CSS variables) to the selected provider. Review also sends a contrast report (element descriptions and colors, no text). With “Send screenshot” on, a downscaled screenshot of the visible part of the page is sent too, and it can show page text. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

optionsRemoveProtectionConfirm.message: Store your API keys unencrypted again?

optionsRestricted.message: Now enabled only on the sites listed.

optionsShadowHelp.message: (themes more of some sites, but can change how components look)

optionsThemesLead.message: Choose where each style applies. Patterns: example.com · *.example.com (with subdomains) · example.com/docs/* (path) · * (every site). The most specific match wins.

optionsUnlockFirst.message: Unlock your API keys first (Key protection).
